# ✨ About

**X Shadow Music** is an **Advanced, Superfast & Smart Telegram VC Music Bot** built using modern libraries and optimized for lightning-fast performance.

Enjoy crystal-clear music streaming with low latency in Telegram voice chats.

---

# ⚡ Features

- 🎵 High Quality Audio
- 🚀 Ultra Fast Streaming
- 🎙 Voice Chat Support
- ❤️ Beautiful UI
- 🔀 Queue System
- 📂 Playlist
- 🔎 YouTube Search
- ⏩ Skip
- ⏸ Pause
- ▶ Resume
- 🔊 Volume Control
- 📜 Lyrics
- 🌍 Multi Language
- 👮 Admin Only Commands
- 📡 Live Streaming
- 🎧 Radio Mode
- 🔁 Loop Mode
- 💾 Cache System
- ⚡ Optimized Performance
- 🔒 Secure System

---

# 🛠 Powered By

- 🐍 Python
- 🔥 Pyrogram
- 🎙 PyTgCalls
- ▶️ YouTube-Search-Python
- 🔐 TgCrypto
- 🎶 FFmpeg
- 🌐 yt-dlp
- ⚡ AsyncIO
- 🍃 Motor
- 🍀 MongoDB

---

# 🚀 Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/XSHADOWMUSIC/X_SHADOW_MUSIC.git

cd X_SHADOW_MUSIC

pip install -U -r requirements.txt

python3 -m SankiMusic
```

---

# ⚙ Environment Variables

```env
API_ID=
API_HASH=
BOT_TOKEN=
STRING_SESSION=
MONGO_DB_URI=
OWNER_ID=
LOG_GROUP_ID=
```
